rows.detail: Release #183 edge audit: the current Watercolor style reference has visible unpainted paper at the perimeter despite its original checker pass. Retained original image and original answer are unchanged. The revised perimeter/corner checker classified this exact image as non-full-bleed in all 3 repeats (2026-10-21); see llm/releases/2026-10-20-watercolor-edge-check. Regenerate or omit the faulty optional reference before evaluating the corrected style. This attention note does not invalidate, unpin, replace or delete the reference; public generic admission remains disabled.
